description: Amendments to the Social Security Board Act, No.17 of 1996
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Social Security Board has been established by the Social Security Board Act, No.17 of 1996, and the said Board introduces and implements various retirement schemes with the aim of providing pensions and social security benefits to self-employed persons who are not engaged in fisheries and agriculture. Cabinet approval has been granted previously to amend the Social Security Board Act to expand the target groups for the pension schemes implemented by the Sri Lanka Social Security Board. Based on the said approval, the proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the final Bill, also incorporating further amendments identified for the Bill already prepared by the Legal Draftsman, was approved by the Cabinet.
